synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (x=row). A1-A4 move the selection: the axis moves by row within bounds; a piece moves within bounds and cannot overlap another piece. A5 cycles axis -> pieces (largest first, ties by min block) -> axis. A7 undoes the last position change and costs nothing.
Reflection of piece block (r,c) is (2A-r,c), clipped and skipped on piece blocks. Render layers are wall<target<reflection<piece; a hole shows the first solid sprite below it, otherwise the first fill (selected = 0, reflection = 4). Objects are re-extracted by colour (wall/player components include 0 cells; 0-only components count in the rank).
Missed mechanic at step 64 (budget): the first 64 non-A7 actions are free, then counter h=128-n and y=64-h. n is hidden state, gated on continuity; fallback n=128-h, or 0 when h=64.
Once the budget starts shrinking, the spent HUD segment ranks as one extra player component, so piece_i becomes piece_{i+1}; wall names are not shifted.
